title: The Squeeze
summary: Mandatory school/training plus two discretionary slices per day. The gap between what players want to spend time on and what time they actually have is the whole engine of this stretch.
structure: Mandatory school and mandatory harmonics/sync training eat most of each day; see campaign/config.json timeEconomy for the discretionary-slice menu.
requiredBeats: Seed exactly one dangling thread: who was originally meant to be in that chair on Day 1? Don't resolve it yet.

Let at least one multi-day investment (an Investigation, a Frame Modification) get interrupted or destroyed by a scheduled emergency partway through — the squeeze should occasionally actually squeeze.
